A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same AttriBoT work. All 29 pages in each version, including Figures 1–11, Tables 1–2, equations, and Appendices A–D, are available and support reliable comparison.

before.justification: Section 4 and Appendix C report original attribution experiments on SQuAD 2.0, HotpotQA, and QASPER, including efficiency, attribution faithfulness, and agreement with human annotations.

after.justification: v2 retains the original experimental results in Section 4 and Appendix C, including benchmark comparisons and analyses of AttriBoT's components.

M1.justification: Section 3 retains identical procedures for KV caching, hierarchical attribution, proxy modeling, proxy model pruning, and their combinations.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate the same open-book QA datasets: SQuAD 2.0, HotpotQA, and QASPER. The human-annotation evaluation and appendix test scenarios are also unchanged.

E2.justification: The corresponding comparisons retain attention weights, gradient norm, sentence similarity, and ContextCite, alongside exact LOO as a reference. No comparator is added or removed.

E3.justification: Model configurations, preprocessing, prompts, and evaluation metrics are unchanged in Section 4.1 and Appendix B. Table 2 retains 1,000 HotpotQA examples, 1,000 SQuAD 2.0 examples, and 998 QASPER examples.

E4.justification: Both versions contain the same approximation checks, component trade-off analyses, mismatched-proxy experiments, and human-annotation comparisons in Section 4.2 and Appendix C.

E5.justification: Run, seed, and uncertainty reporting are unchanged. Appendix B.2 retains the same ESD procedure and parameters; adding 1969 to the Grubbs citation does not revise the statistical method.

E6.justification: All reported experimental values, plotted points, rankings, and findings match. Figures 1–11 and Table 2 retain the same results, with no added or removed result entries.

T1.justification: The attribution definitions, efficiency formulas in Table 1, derivations in Appendix A, and statistical formulas in Appendix B.2 are unchanged.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same contributions and claims, including greater-than-300-fold speedup and a Pareto-optimal efficiency–faithfulness trade-off.

C2.justification: Interpretations and qualifications are unchanged, including discussion of mismatched proxies in Appendix C.3 and duplicated-input limitations in Appendix D.2.

D1.justification: Hardware information, preprocessing instructions, prompts, hyperparameter guidance, and the implementation link are unchanged. The expanded references add no implementation or reproducibility details.

R1.justification: The cited works and research positioning remain the same. Added identifiers, expanded author lists, and updated publication metadata, including Gravel et al.'s journal information, concern already-cited works.

P1.justification: v2 expands and standardizes bibliographic metadata, supplies the missing year in the Appendix B.2 Grubbs citation, and updates the arXiv version stamp. Scientific prose and section organization are unchanged.

P2.justification: Longer reference entries change line wrapping, spacing, and reference placement across pages 13–20. All figures, tables, captions, and their placement remain unchanged.

improvement.justification: v2 modestly improves reference completeness and traceability by adding arXiv identifiers, fuller publication details, and the missing Grubbs year. These are useful editorial improvements; the scientific content, experimental support, and limitations remain unchanged.
